title: Reference in other sections.
bodyText: Any reference throughout the Hawaii Revised Statutes to book and page after December 31, 1989, shall also refer to book and page or document number.
bodyHtml: [§502-31.5]  Reference in other sections.  Any reference throughout the Hawaii Revised Statutes to book and page after December 31, 1989, shall also refer to book and page or document number. [L 1989, c 47, §1]
